title: Market prices
subtitle: Retail food prices in Bangladesh: today's prices in Dhaka from the Trading Corporation of Bangladesh (TCB), and monthly prices across the country from the World Food Programme (WFP).
snapshotSubtitle: National retail prices of key staples
nationalCaption: National retail price of each item in its latest month, with the change from the previous month and the trend over the last {n} months
footnote: Monthly retail prices, median of WFP-monitored markets
unavailable: Market prices are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
districtHint: WFP monitors markets in {n} districts. Choose one to see the latest prices recorded there.
farFromNational: Very different from the national price
note1: These are monthly retail prices — what shoppers pay in local markets — collected by the World Food Programme (WFP) in a sample of markets. They are not wholesale prices, and not the farm-gate prices farmers receive.
note2: The national price is the median of the markets that reported that month, and is shown only when markets in at least {n} districts reported. A district's price is the median of its monitored markets.
note3: The change compares the same markets with the previous month that has data, and is left out when that month is more than {gap} months earlier.
note4: WFP publishes with a delay, so the latest month is often one to three months ago and can differ between items. Prices in your own market may differ.
todaySubtitle: Collected every day by the Trading Corporation of Bangladesh (TCB) in Dhaka city markets.
todayCaption: Lowest and highest retail price of each item in Dhaka on {date}, with the change from a week, a month and a year earlier
todayFootnote: Lowest–highest retail price in Dhaka city markets. The change compares the middle of each price range.
todayUnavailable: Today's Dhaka prices are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
